system.description:
The ultimate sealing technique. Its power adjusts to the strength of the one bound with it. While a creature has River Dam Seal, the Sealed conditions, effects are suppressed, but they are still present on a creature. A creature can only remove ranks of sealed, one at a time per effect or action that would remove them. While they are afflicted with River Dam Seal, but also cannot gain new ranks of Sealed while afflicted with River Dam Seal. A creature with River Dam seal suffers the following effects based on their Adversary Classification;

Applies to All Afflicted Creatures

Increase the cost of Jutsu by +20.

Afflicted creature cannot teleport.

Afflicted creature cannot maintain concentration on jutsu.

A creature with 0 ranks of Sealed loses this condition.

Applies to Standards

Reduce the damage you deal by -8

Afflicted creature cannot cast jutsu that require Chakra Molding (CM) that are of C-Rank or higher.

Applies to Elites

Reduce the damage you deal by -10

You cannot regain Tenacity die.

Afflicted creature cannot cast jutsu that require Chakra Molding (CM) that are of B-Rank or higher.

Applies to Solo’s

Reduce the damage you deal by -12

Whenever you spend a Tenacity die, you lose 1 Tenacity die.

Afflicted creature cannot cast jutsu that require Chakra Molding (CM) that are of A-Rank or higher.

Applies to Player Characters

Reduce the damage you deal by -10

Afflicted creature cannot upcast.

Afflicted creature cannot cast jutsu that require Chakra Molding (CM) that are of their highest rank known.
system.summary: Jutsu cost +20; no teleporting or concentrating; Sealed suppressed; more by adversary class (damage, Chakra Molding ranks).

rules.text: Sealed's effects are suppressed (still present); ranks of Sealed come off one at a time and no new ones are gained; it ends at 0 Sealed. Can't teleport or maintain concentration.

By classification: Standard −8 damage, no CM jutsu of C-Rank+; Elite −10 damage, no Tenacity dice regained, no CM jutsu of B-Rank+; Solo −12 damage, lose a Tenacity die whenever it spends one, no CM jutsu of A-Rank+; Player Character −10 damage, no upcasting, no CM jutsu of its highest rank known.
